name: int-maj
description: International mahjong (The Game of Mah Jong Illustrated) on a 3D table, played offline against bots.

scripts.deploy: npm test && npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.158.0 deploy
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run preview
scripts.pretest: node -e "if (+process.versions.node.split('.')[0] < 24) { console.error('int-maj needs Node 24 or later (see .nvmrc); this is Node ' + process.version + '.'); process.exit(1); }"
